paragraphs.text: The Battle at Mors Ridge was an event during the Time of Legends , on the continent of Corondor .

Ham, the Tickery Man was a member of the High Council of Mors Ridge who was in charge of casting the "tickery" spell, making sure the slumbering Elder Dragon Palladia-Mors remained in stasis beneath Mors Ridge , keeping her from attacking humans. However, Palladia's cousin Vaevictis Asmadi managed to wake her up to lift the curse that had turned him into a Dragon Whelp . Palladia undid the spell. and together with an army, they went on the rampage. The Tickery Man Ham then revealed himself to be Palladia's brother, Chromium Rhuell , and was able to convince Vaevictis to turn on Palladia. However, Palladia was ready for this, reversing one of Vaevictis' spells , and he disappeared from the battle, never to be seen again. Finally, Chromium and Red Donald's daughter Ad'Amra , a human warrior spellcaster who had fallen in love with "Ham", managed to put the sleep-spell back on Palladia.

Although there is great uncertainty about when this event took place, it is explicitly stated as happening before the Brothers' War , which started in 28 AR . Additionally, it must have happened after the Blackblade–Dihada War , as Chromium Rhuell is mourning the death of Piru , which happened then. This puts the event at most some centuries (-1300 AR ) before the start of the Brothers' War.
